description: Get price history for one product (by Prickelly or shop product id, or a product URL). Returns recent points, min, max, current, and a short verdict based only on that history. No sign-in required.

days.description: History window in days, default 90, max 365.

lang.description: Output language: "en" or "tr". Defaults to the user's language when the client says it, otherwise English.

marketplace.description: Optional marketplace when only a product id is given.

product.description: Product id or shop / Prickelly history URL.

productId.description: Product id, for example HBCV00008O0L2Z or an Amazon ASIN.

url.description: Product URL from Amazon.com.tr, Hepsiburada, Trendyol, or a Prickelly history link.

name: get_price_history
title: Get price history
